engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Immobilizer active (Engine shuts OFF after 2-3 Seconds)
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Immobilizer Pickup Coil (D2) faulty
Immobilzier Kontrol Modülü / Elektronik Beyin (ECU/TCM) Donanımsal Arızalı
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Immobilizer Pickup Coil (D2)

Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Immobilizer Pickup Coil (D2)
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
technicalNotes: Pickup Coils for Immobilizer 2 and 3 Systems should read ~ 18 to 24 Ω
